## Methods

::: {.workflow-tables}
### Lotus screened Slater exchange, $6\text{-}31\mathrm{G}$, fixed geometry

A reference screening calculation: Lotus iterates the density, screened Slater exchange and electronic response together at the fixed benzene geometry of the supplied example, in the $6\text{-}31\mathrm{G}$ basis, until $\varepsilon_s$ converges.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Accepted](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/check.svg "Accepted: The self-consistent screening and its numerical consistency checks passed."){.workflow-status} | 17 Oct 2026 | [Benzene electronic screening $\varepsilon_s$](2026-10-17_122144/) | Converges the electronic screening $\varepsilon_s$ of benzene. |

### B3LYP and DD-DFT, checkpoint-chained guesses

B3LYP and DD-DFT, BLYP weighted by the Lotus screening, run as a chain in which each Gaussian step reads its geometry and orbitals from the previous step's checkpoint.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Superseded by the independent-guess rebuild."){.workflow-status} | 21–23 Oct 2026 | [[Benzene with checkpoint-chained guesses](2026-10-21_164931/)]{.rejected} | [Compares screening and $S_0\rightarrow S_n$ absorption of benzene with the gas-phase spectrum.]{.rejected} |
| ![Rejected](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/cross.svg "Rejected: Its B3LYP results are suspect: total energies and HOMO–LUMO gaps were never checked, and a calculation restarted from a checkpoint appears to have converged to a wrong electronic solution, so the B3LYP and DD-DFT comparison is not reliable; the runs are kept as history. Superseded by the independent-guess rebuild."){.workflow-status} | 21–26 Oct 2026 | [[Methoxy difluoroboron chelate (1) with checkpoint-chained guesses](2026-10-21_164940/)]{.rejected} | [Compares absorption and $S_1$ relaxation of methoxy chelate 1 with the measured spectra.]{.rejected} |

### B3LYP and DD-DFT, independent guesses, stability-checked

The same B3LYP and DD-DFT sequence, with each run starting from logged coordinates and Gaussian's default guess and testing the stability of its SCF solution before use.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Accepted](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/check.svg "Accepted: Without checkpoint reuse, the B3LYP and DD-DFT spectra match the checkpoint-chained ones within 3\,\mathrm{meV}, so checkpoint reuse did not change the benzene results. A second geometry/screening cycle makes the DD-DFT weights self-consistent with the geometry and moves the spectrum by at most 2.7\,\mathrm{meV}. Supersedes the checkpoint-chained workflow, rebuilt without checkpoint reuse."){.workflow-status} | 29–30 Oct 2026 | [Benzene with independent guesses](2026-10-29_183718/) | Rebuilds the benzene comparison without checkpoint reuse, recording energies, orbital gaps and wavefunction stability. |
|  | 28 Oct 2026 | Methoxy difluoroboron chelate (1) with independent guesses | Rebuilds the methoxy comparison without checkpoint reuse, recording energies, orbital gaps and wavefunction stability. |
